comment: Invoice says 12 licences, we have 9. Third month running.
Delivery was promised Tuesday, arrived the following Monday with no update in between.
App logs me out every time I switch networks. I have to sign in 4 or 5 times a day.
Raised a ticket on the 3rd, first human reply on the 11th.
Billed twice in March. Refund took 6 weeks and I had to chase it 3 times.
The reporting screen is genuinely good. No complaints there.
Login drops me out constantly and the invoice this month was wrong again, charged for a user who left in January.
Nobody told us the delivery window had changed. We had 2 people waiting at the warehouse.
Support closed my ticket without resolving it and I had to open a new one.
Charged for the annual plan when I had moved to monthly. Took 4 emails to sort out.
Cannot stay signed in on the mobile app at all. Desktop is fine.
Your team was very good about the warehouse mix-up, credit where it is due.
The invoice layout is confusing. I cannot tell what I am being charged for.
Waited 9 days for a response on a billing question. That is not acceptable.
Shipment arrived damaged and the replacement took another 2 weeks.
Password reset email never arrives. I have tried 3 times this week.
Being charged for a seat we cancelled in November.
Delivery driver could not find the loading bay. Third time this has happened.
Support reply was a link to a help article that did not answer the question.
Two invoices for the same month with different totals. Which one do I pay?
App crashes when I open the export screen on a large account.
No acknowledgement of my ticket for 5 days. I assumed it had been lost.
Pricing page says one figure, the invoice says another. The difference is tax but it does not say so.
Delivery is consistently 2 days later than the confirmation email says.
Signed out mid-way through filling a long form and lost everything.
Billing contact is still my predecessor who left a year ago. I cannot change it myself.
Support were excellent once I reached a person. Reaching a person took a week.
Export to CSV silently drops the last column.
Invoiced in the wrong currency and the conversion was not explained.
Order confirmation never arrived, so we ordered again and got 2 deliveries.
The session times out after 15 minutes of inactivity which is far too short for how we work.
Asked 3 times for a VAT invoice and still have not received one.
Courier left the package outside in the rain.
Cannot log in on Safari at all. Works on Chrome.
Charged a late fee for an invoice you sent to the wrong address.
Ticket was escalated and then nobody followed up for 8 days.
The new dashboard is faster than the old one. Noticeably.
Delivery note had the wrong quantity so our goods-in rejected the whole pallet.
Two-factor codes arrive 2 or 3 minutes late, by which time they have expired.
Still waiting on a credit note promised on the 14th.
